facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance and Ghana Revenue Authority said Publican Trade Solution, an AI-based tool helping customs officers value and classify imports, was fully rolled out at ports of entry on 11 March 2026 beside ICUMS.

The Ministry of Finance said that since its introduction on 11 March 2026 Publican Trade Solution had endorsed clearing of 75.3 percent of customs declarations and flagged 24.7 percent as below accepted global values.
